translation.name: Kalam Baybol Buk Gor minim nuk kisin angayak

content: Enjol Miker Yomb Onep Ar Ak Dand Wiyak

Pen day niŋiy niŋnik: minim bap Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan biyaŋ nimb enjol onep ar ak kuyip, suk yomb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Biynimb timey gipay rek Gor miluk yapek, kuyip miker ñiniŋg, diys onep ar tumb biyoŋ aranjakiy mindip gok, dam lum ar biyaŋ soŋgem amnaŋ aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgek, enjol nind ak diys nuk dam lum ar biyaŋ soŋgek, biynimb tap ayndik kil nup ak diy, tap nup rek gayeyak lotiw giyak gok, kuyip soy ayndik yiwur yomb sikerek gak gok ayak.
Enjol namb ak, diys nuk dam ñiŋg solwara ar ak soŋgek, ñiŋg solwara ak, biynimb ñaŋgey likañ wip rek ak ay, tap ñiŋg solwara namb kun okok mindeyak gok, maŋgiysek kumdiyak.
Enjol namb kaneŋ ak, diys nuk dam ñiŋg kilam jiwip gok sek, yikop apyowip ar gok sek soŋgek, ñiŋg gok maŋgiysek likañ ayak.
Pen enjol ñiŋg maŋgiysek kond mindip ak aŋgak, “Gor. Nand kuyip niŋind yimb kun gipan. Nand Bi suŋ-tep yimb. Nind yimb yimb mindiy, mind dand apiy, mindnep mindpan.
Biynimb kun gok nep mey, biynimb nip ker gok kuyip pikay, bi minim nip aŋgep gok kuyip, ñaŋgayey likañ yowak ak mey, kuyip pen kunep likañ ñey ñimbsipay ak, giy dispay aŋgak.”

Kun aŋgek, minim bap Gor nup simboŋgep bind ar ak nimb aŋgak, “Gor. Nand Biyomb yimb; biynimb tap okok maŋgiysek kond mindpan. Biynimb gok kuyip yiwur ñimban ak, gipay rek niŋiy, pen kunep gipan aŋgak.”
Enjol tiŋgawip ak, diys nuk dam pumb anup soŋgek, biynimb gok kuyip sinjrimey yimb niŋnimuŋ rek ayak.
Sinjrimey yimb niŋiy, kuyip tapin yinak ak pen; yenen timey gipun aŋgiy mindrep giy, yimb nup ak ma dand araniyak. Chinup miker ñisap aŋgiy, nup aŋgjiwyak.

Enjol mamind ak, diys nuk dam tap ayndik siya kiyŋ mindek ar siŋak soŋgek, biynimb nuk kond mindyiŋgip namb ak, kisyim yiwiŋg dak. Soy ayndik ay, yiwur yomb gek, alemb siwbirikyak ak pen; timey giyak ar ak ma kirgiyak; giyiŋg nep mindiy, Gor semb biyoŋ nup aŋgjiwyak.

Enjol kaŋgol ak, bi kiyŋ yomb miñmon pumb limgip okok nimb ap, Siypsiyp Ñiluk ak yip penpen giniŋgambay ñin ak wip rek, ap penpen giniŋgiy aŋgiy, diys nuk ak dam ñiŋg yomb Yiwpreytiys soŋgek, ñiŋg kun ak pisnep milip gak.

Kun gakniŋ, malñiluk as rek ayak omiŋal nokom niŋnik. Bap ñom nim meŋg miŋgan ak nimb aranjakak; bap tap ayndik meŋg miŋgan ak nimb aranjakak; bap bi Gor minim aspiyn aŋgiy, yesek nep aŋgniŋgamb ak meŋg miŋgan biyaŋ nimb aranjakak.

Malñiluk kun gok, Seytan ñapan nuk yimb ak mey, tap mageprek gok giniŋgiy rek ayak. Gor ñin yomb nuk ak, giniŋgamb rek niŋiy niŋnik; kiyk am kiyŋ miñmon keykey mindpay rek amiy, kuyip poŋind apiy, Gor bi tap okok maŋgiysek alwol gayak ak yip penpen gey amnak.

“Niŋrep ginimimb! Yand winiŋg, bi tap siydep gok ma niŋmindpay won ak, opay rek ak winiŋgayn! Kun ak mey, biynimb wisin ma kiniy, chech ayrep giy mindeniŋgambay gok kuyip, nambiŋ ma giniŋgamb; kuyip den miñmiñ giniŋgambay!”
Pen malñiluk kun gok, bi kiyŋ miñmon keykey gok kuyip, dap nan-giniŋgambay miñmon ak, Hiybriw minim aŋgiy Amagedon apay.
Enjol ar ak, diys nuk ak soŋgak namb nep ar bikyoŋ. Soŋgek, minim bap siya kiyŋ Gor aŋgniŋep korip miŋgan biyaŋ nimb suk yomb aŋgiy aŋgak, “Miker yomb gok day jiwip aŋgak.”
Kun aŋgakniŋ, timuk aŋgiy giw aŋgek amnakniŋ, añiñak diyiŋg kasin maŋgiy bol gok yap pikiy, monmon yomb sikerek biynimb mankumb biy, nind ma niŋyiŋgipay rek bap awak.

Monmon yomb sikerek kun ak diy, dawin yomb Babiylon ak biw aŋgiy, asik taw omiŋal nokom ay, dawin yomb miñmon keykey okok maŋgiysek, korip tap gok puŋgjiw kosiy masiy gak. Gak kun ak, Gor nup miluk yimb yapek, Babiylon biynimb giyak ak sakiy ma giy, kuyip ñiŋg silik kap tumb biyoŋ aranjakak ak, ñek ñiŋyak.
Pen miñmon sikoy ñiŋg timb kus gak gok sek, miñmon yirik gok sek pisnep kurgak.
Miker yomb yimb ak mey, dikiy niŋgomb maŋgiy yomb sikerek gok semb biyoŋ nimb yapiy, biynimb gok kuyip sinjrimey yimb pikak. Kuyip sinjrimey yimb pikek niŋiy, Gor nup pisnep aŋgjiwyak.
